quota_note: Free plan project DB size limit is 500 MB; source exceeds both 500 million and 500 MiB bytes. This is NOT a measured target database size; archives/TOAST/indexes can differ after restore.
size_note: pg_total_relation_size includes heap, indexes, TOAST. This is an optimization hypothesis only. Excluding rows is NOT authorized until restored immutable full archive and verified runtime/history compatibility.
gates: Complete private source+target backups and isolated restore rehearsal
Preserve original positive/negative/error learning observations, hashes and retrieval method
Prove source/target functional parity with historic result lookup and lossless archival indexing
Trace auto tasks/dependencies before moving history outside active DB
Measure target size, p95 and functional/user-visible improvement and rollback
Obtain user PASS or FAIL after working target verification

referential_integrity_audit.limitation: Zero catalog foreign keys/triggers does not establish absence of dynamic SQL, Edge Function, client, cron, materialized-view or code-level dependencies. Archive retrieval and learning behavior must be verified.
